evals.name: offline-saas-happy-path
evals.prompt: Build the deterministic Marketing Brain demo vault for a synthetic B2B SaaS site. Run scaffold, fixture import, keyword workbook build, PAA digest creation, synthesis, report HTML smoke, and vault lint.
evals.expected_output: examples/sample-vault exists, has no real client data, passes vault lint, includes keywords-2026-05-11.csv/xlsx, has a populated ULTIMATE BEAST Plan with source citations, and renders HTML without local filesystem paths.

evals.name: different-vertical-local-services
evals.prompt: Scaffold a Marketing Brain vault for a synthetic local services company using local-seo-services. Verify the active business-type overlay is copied and no SaaS-specific assumptions dominate the core flow.
evals.expected_output: The vault has local SEO overlay content, Day 0 measurement gate, GBP/review/citation considerations, and passes vault lint.

evals.name: missing-credentials-error
evals.prompt: Attempt a live DataForSEO command without DATAFORSEO_LOGIN or DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD.
evals.expected_output: The command exits non-zero before paid API calls and prints a clear error naming both required environment variables.

evals.name: dry-run-cost-preview
evals.prompt: Run competitor, ranked-keyword, and PAA commands with --dry-run.
evals.expected_output: Each command prints planned endpoints, call counts, estimated cost, and writes no paid API response files.

evals.name: release-package-secret-scan
evals.expected_output: Template, sample-vault, source ZIPs, RELEASE_MANIFEST.json, and SHA256SUMS are created; scans reject secrets, .env files, private keys, local home paths, cache folders, and real client domains.

notes: All default evals use synthetic domains and fixtures. Live DataForSEO verification is a separate gated release check when credentials are available.
